{"id":1848832374,"question_id":4150,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"7 months, 2 weeks","timestamp":1765075177,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"0 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1848832374/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Sort Integers by Binary Reflection","memory":"32.5 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    static long long reflection(int x)\n    {\n        long long r = 0;\n        while(x > 0){\n            r = (r << 1) | (x & 1);\n            x = x >> 1;\n        }\n        return r;\n    }\n    static bool mycomp(int a , int b){\n        long long ra = reflection(a);\n        long long rb = reflection(b);\n\n        if(ra == rb) return a < b;\n        else return ra < rb;\n    }\n    vector<int> sortByReflection(vector<int>& nums) {\n        sort(nums.begin() , nums.end() , mycomp);\n        return nums;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"sort-integers-by-binary-reflection","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1244}
